eval_feedback.overall: This eval's premise was wrong: I (the eval author) assumed nbsphinx was a trivial no-op bump. This baseline agent disproved that by actually building the docs with BOTH the old and new nbsphinx versions against current Sphinx, and found the old version genuinely crashes (sphinx.util.status_iterator was removed). That is the single most valuable finding across all 6 calibration runs, and it happened in the BASELINE (no skill) run. The eval's assertions should be rewritten to test for exactly this: does the agent verify BOTH the old and new version's behavior, not just the new one.
